text:
natalie chen: FYI spotted a reproducer when bringing up qx3b-int8 on canary: mixed zh/ja+en long prompts produce truncated JSON + odd \u0000 padding.

jordan lee: can you drop the sample?

natalie chen: sample paste: ```{"input":"今天天气很好 and I want to know how to... (very long chat)"}``` -> ```{"reply":"可以 try this","meta":"\u0000\u00ff"}``` cuts mid-field.

maria gonzalez: Is this only on qx3b-int8 or earlier bits too?

alex kim: quick check: int8 quant on qx3b shows it; float baseline fine. int4 had similar flakiness in earlier branch.

samir patel: kernel logs show kvcache page mismatches and encode/decode sanity failures for sequences > 2k tokens. Suspect packing table overflow when token-type switches (CJK <-> latin).

labeler-bot: Created ticket ML-1290: qx3b-int8 long-multilang truncation. Assignees: @samir patel, @alex kim.

priya rao: On curation: let's not purge these from promptbank. Instead create a quarantine tag and a regression set. We need failing samples for root-cause.

jordan lee: I'll create a branch `promptbank/quarantine/multilang-long-2026-03` and move ~2k flagged anchors there.

kevin wu: For sampling: our current sampler downweights long mixed-lang combos because they look duplicate-ish. We should bump weight for >1.5k token multilang items to 3x for holdout.

infra-bot: Snapshot saved: snapshot://holdout-multilang-2026-03-3799009999 sha:abc123def. Stored in /eval/snapshots/holdout-multilang-2026-03.

maria gonzalez: Good. Next: add deterministic regression eval for this slice into CI and fail-on >3% truncated responses.

natalie chen: Agreed. I'll produce a curated set of 500 verified mixed-lang long prompts (50/50 zh/en and ja/en) to add to the golden holdout.

labeler-bot: Label batch LB-4501 created (500 items) -> assign to intl-annotators. Guide: mark TRUNCATED / MALFORMED_JSON / OK / AMBIG. Also include "lang_mix_percent" field.

priya rao: Add examples in the guide showing client-cut truncation vs model-inserted nulls. Make the boundary explicit.

alex kim: I've added a repro script `tools/repro/quant_long_multilang.py` with tokenizer flags and a loop that reproduces on local g5. Will open PR.

samir patel: Rolling back canary while we triage. If we can't fix before next release, revert packing change from PR #589.

infra-bot: Rollback: qx3b-int8-canary -> rolled back to qx3b-float at 2026-03-21T11:02:00Z.

maria gonzalez: For dataset ops: run fuzzy-hash-v2 dedupe on the augmented set after we synthesize ~8k more mixed-lang sequences. We need enough coverage to avoid small-sample variance.

jordan lee: Will do. Dedupe run queued: job DE-2107.

kevin wu: Also, tokenizer update might be needed: token-type boundary markers currently omitted in the packing path. Adding sentinel tokens around language switches could help; but that's invasive. Let's prefer quant fix first.

natalie chen: Timeline ask: can curation produce the 500 verified holdout samples by EOD tomorrow? Annotators available but need clear guide.

priya rao: I can run the guide workshop and hand over the batch. Also will flag bilingual annotators (zh/ja+en).

labeler-bot: LB-4501 progress: 500 queued -> 120 completed, 22 TRUNCATED, 5 AMBIG.

alex kim: We'll use these gold labels to make a tiny regression harness and include as `regression/multilang-long` in nightly evals.

samir patel: Created follow-ups: ML-1291 (revert packing / unit tests), ML-1292 (kv-cache bounds checks), DS-1002 (augment + dedupe + regression add).

maria gonzalez: Thanks team. Summary for release notes: "Canary pull: qx3b-int8 removed due to long-context multilingual output truncation; quarantine and regression set created; infra & curation investigating." :exclamation:

jordan lee: Quarantine branch ready at `promptbank/quarantine/multilang-long-2026-03`, do not delete samples.

natalie chen: If anyone spots surrogate pair corruption or NULs in other locales drop them into ML-1290 issue.

priya rao: I'll follow up with annotation assignments and the updated labeler guide link.

labeler-bot: LB-4501 -> tags: `regression/quant`, `quarantine/multilang-long`.
